greater than on the flat surface less than on the flat surface

Which situation cannot be explained using this relationship?

options.text: Using a longer spanner than normal to undo a tight nut.
Hammering a nail into a piece of wood.

A sharp kitchen knife cutting vegetables more easily than a blunt one.

A person stands 1.0m in front of a plane mirror. The mirror is moved away from the person at a
speed of 1.0m/s.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The image moves away from the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.
The image moves away from the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.
